subject: makeup sponge
title: What If You Never Washed Your Makeup Sponge?

scenes.text: What if you never washed your makeup sponge? It looks clean. Up close, it really isn't.
Every use, it soaks up foundation, skin oil and water, then sits damp in a bag for hours.
Damp and dark is perfect for bacteria. Aston University scientists tested used makeup from real people's bags.
About nine in ten products carried bacteria like E. coli and staph. Sponges had the highest levels of all.
93 percent of the sponges had never been cleaned, and 64 percent had been dropped on the floor.
So every morning, some people are pressing a little bit of their bathroom floor right onto their face.

description:
What if you never washed your makeup sponge? A 2019 Aston University study found potentially harmful bacteria such as E. coli and staph in about nine in ten used makeup products, with sponges the most contaminated.
93% of the sponges had never been cleaned and 64% had been dropped on the floor at some point.
